name: Kyberion Meeting Copilot
description: Drives meeting participation (join / mute / leave / captions) for Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom on behalf of the Kyberion meeting coordinator via a local WebSocket control channel, and summarizes the live captions on-device with Chrome Built-in AI (Gemini Nano). Runs inside the operator's own signed-in Chrome — no bot session, no CDP.
